description:
Digital signatures for docx, pptx and xlsx: sign an OPC package (XML-DSig,
		XAdES-EPES or XAdES-T) as Office does, validate signatures made by Office or
		by docx4j, list and remove them, and sign Word and Excel signature lines.
		Formerly Plutext DigSig (CR-033). The core is adapted from Apache POI's
		poifs.crypt.dsig; the XML security work is Apache Santuario's.
